(defn run [observe]
  (do (do (do (assert (= [2 1] (let [[a b] [1 2]] [b a]))) (assert (= #{1 2} (let [[a b] [1 2]] #{a b}))) (assert (= [1 2] (let [{a :a b :b} {:a 1 :b 2}] [a b]))) (assert (= [1 2] (let [{:keys [a b]} {:a 1 :b 2}] [a b]))) (assert (= [1 2 [1 2]] (let [[a b :as v] [1 2]] [a b v]))) (assert (= [1 42] (let [{:keys [a b] :or {b 42}} {:a 1}] [a b]))) (assert (= [1 nil] (let [{:keys [a b] :or {c 42}} {:a 1}] [a b]))) (assert (= [2 1] (let [[a b] '(1 2)] [b a]))) (assert (= {1 2} (let [[a b] [1 2]] {a b}))) (assert (= [2 1] (let [[a b] (seq [1 2])] [b a]))) (do (let [{:keys [:a :b]} {:a 1 :b 2}] (do (assert (= 1 a)) (assert (= 2 b)))) (let [{:keys [:a/b :c/d]} {:a/b 1 :c/d 2}] (do (assert (= 1 b)) (assert (= 2 d)))) (let [{:keys [a/b c/d]} {:a/b 1 :c/d 2}] (do (assert (= 1 b)) (assert (= 2 d)))) (let [{:syms [a/b c/d]} {'a/b 1 'c/d 2}] (do (assert (= 1 b)) (assert (= 2 d)))) (let [{:keys [::c/x ::c/y]} {:cljs.core/x 1 :cljs.core/y 2}] (do (assert (= x 1)) (assert (= y 2)))))) true)))

(ns cljs.binding-test
  (:require [cljs.binding-test-other-ns :as o]))

(defn test-binding []
  (assert (binding [o/*foo* 2]
        (= o/*foo* 2)))
  (assert (= o/*foo* 1)))

(defn test-with-redefs []
  (assert (with-redefs [o/bar 2]
        (= o/bar 2)))
  (assert (= o/bar 10)))

(def ^:dynamic *a* 1)
(def ^:dynamic *b* nil)

(defn test-binding-parallel []
  (assert (= 2 (binding [*a* 10
                     *b* (inc *a*)]
             *b*))))

(def a 1)
(def b nil)

(defn test-redefs-parallel []
  (assert (= 2 (with-redefs [a 10
                         b (inc a)]
             b))))

(def ^:dynamic *foo* false)
(def ^:dynamic ^boolean *foo-tagged* false)

(defn bar [] (if *foo* 1 2))
(defn bar-tagged [] (if *foo-tagged* 1 2))

(defn test-tag-inference []
  (assert (= 2 (bar)))
  (binding [*foo* "abc"]
    (assert (= 1 (bar))))
  (binding [*foo* ""]
    (assert (= 1 (bar))))

  (assert (= 2 (bar-tagged)))
  (binding [*foo-tagged* "abc"]
    (assert (= 1 (bar-tagged))))
  (binding [*foo-tagged* ""]
    (assert (= 2 (bar-tagged)))))

(defn run [observe] (test-binding) (test-with-redefs) (test-binding-parallel) (test-redefs-parallel) (test-tag-inference) true)
run

(ns cljs.var-test)

(defn cljs-3411-function
  "this function adds two numbers"
  {:test #(do
            (assert (= (cljs-3411-function 2 3) 5))
            (assert (= (cljs-3411-function 4 4) 8)))}
  ([x y] (+ x y)))

(defn cljs-3411 []
  (do
    (assert (= :ok (test cljs-3411-function)))
    (assert (= :ok (test #'cljs-3411-function)))))

(defn run [observe] (cljs-3411) true)
run

(ns interop.main (:refer-global :only [String Object]))
(defn run [observe]
  (assert (= ["FOO" "BAR" "BAZ"]
             (map String/.toUpperCase ["foo" "bar" "baz"])))
  (let [f (fn [] String/.toUpperCase) m (f)]
    (assert (= "FOO" (m "foo"))))
  (let [f Object/new] (assert (some? (f))))
  true)
run

(ns cljs.core-test)


(deftype KeywordTest []
  ILookup
  (-lookup [o k] :nothing)
  (-lookup [o k not-found] not-found))

(defn tset-638 []
  (assert (= (:a (KeywordTest.)) :nothing)))

(deftype MyWatchable []
  IWatchable
  (-notify-watches [this oldval newval])
  (-add-watch [this key f])
  (-remove-watch [this key]))

(defn test-920-watch-ops-return-ref []
  (do
    (let [w (MyWatchable.)]
      (assert (identical? (add-watch w :foo (fn [])) w))
      (assert (identical? (remove-watch w :foo) w)))))

(deftype MyCustomAtom [^:mutable state]
  IDeref
  (-deref [_] state)
  IReset
  (-reset! [_ newval]
    (set! state newval)))

(defn test-919-generic-cas []
  (do
    (let [a0 (MyCustomAtom. 10)
          a1 (MyCustomAtom. 0)]
      (compare-and-set! a0 0 20)
      (compare-and-set! a1 0 20)
      (assert (== @a0 10))
      (assert (== @a1 20)))))

(deftype MapWithNoIKVReduce [backing-map]
  IMap
  (-dissoc [_ _] nil)

  ISeqable
  (-seq [_] (seq backing-map)))

(defn test-cljs-2083 []
  (do
    (assert (true?  (equiv-map (MapWithNoIKVReduce. {:a 1 :b 2 :c 3}) {:a 1 :b 2 :c 3})))
    (assert (false? (equiv-map (MapWithNoIKVReduce. {:a 1 :b 2 :c 3}) {:a 1 :b 2 :c 4})))))

(deftype Foo2407 [x y])
(defrecord Bar2407 [x y])

(defn test-cljs-2407 []
  (assert (= "Positional factory function for cljs.core-test/Foo2407." (:doc (meta #'->Foo2407))))
  (assert (= "Positional factory function for cljs.core-test/Bar2407." (:doc (meta #'->Bar2407))))
  (assert (= "Factory function for cljs.core-test/Bar2407, taking a map of keywords to field values." (:doc (meta #'map->Bar2407)))))

(defn run [observe] (tset-638) (test-920-watch-ops-return-ref) (test-919-generic-cas) (test-cljs-2083) (test-cljs-2407) true)

run

(ns foo.core
  (:refer-clojure :rename {when always map core-map}))

;; Renaming excludes both original names, allowing these ordinary own Vars.
(defn when [] :own-when)
(defn map [] :own-map)

(defn run [observe]
  (assert (= [:own-when :own-map] [(when) (map)]))
  (let [events (atom [])]
    (assert (= :selected (always true (swap! events conj :ran) :selected)))
    (assert (nil? (always false (swap! events conj :unexpected))))
    (assert (= [:ran] @events)))
  (assert (= (always true 42) (cljs.core/when true 42)))
  (assert (identical? core-map cljs.core/map))
  (assert (= [2 3 4] (vec (core-map inc [1 2 3]))))
  true)
run
